dateAlignment.forwardMapping: common-calendar exact rebalance date plus T+n target date; symbols missing either date are excluded

backtest.hitRateMeaning: share of rebalances where the top-quintile mean forward return exceeded the bottom quintile (gross / net of cost)

modelParity.composite: live computeFactorRanks (factor-ranks.js) on factor values known at each rebalance date
modelParity.longShortGross: ±1 legs (spread and cost on the same exposure)

turnover.unit: absolute portfolio-weight change; ±1 gross long/short equal-weight quintiles

liquidity.unitPolicy: native-close-times-volume; USD and KRW are not cross-converted
liquidity.allowedUse: research-only; liquidity is diagnostic, not a fill guarantee

backtest.compWeights: factor-weights.js NEUTRAL renormalized over the computable factors — the same live model default ranking uses (P1449 fingerprint below)
backtest.excludedFactorsReason: size needs historical shares-outstanding data this pipeline does not fetch; value/quality are FMP today-only TTM snapshots with no historical time series, so backtesting them would use look-ahead information
